# BestieFinder

> BestieFinder is a mobile-first social app that matches people with new best friends based on personality, interests, communication style, lifestyle, and goals. Real friendships, no dating app energy.

## Pages

- [Landing](/): Overview of BestieFinder — vibe-based matching, mutual likes, built-in icebreakers, friend groups, and safety features.
- [Onboarding](/onboarding): Multi-step profile creation covering name, age, pronouns, bio, interests, goals, and a vibe-check quiz.
- [Home](/app): Personalized dashboard with today's top match, daily picks, vibe stats, and the icebreaker of the day.
- [Discover](/app/discover): Swipeable card stack of potential best friends with compatibility scoring.
- [Chats](/app/chats): Message matched friends with suggested icebreaker prompts.
- [Groups](/app/groups): Browse and join friend groups for hangouts like brunches, hikes, and movie nights.
- [Profile](/app/profile): Manage your profile, interests, vibe stats, and privacy settings.
